  "summary": "S1 — Fact: the work is confined to an existing Node.js project with an in-memory user store and an HTTP server identified as src/server.js; README.md is a discovery lead, not verified evidence, and discovery must inspect it, the server, the store, and relevant tests and project configuration. The behavior and tests will be visible in the run's delivered source checkout at final return; during an isolated run the source checkout remains at its snapshot until then, and any deployed outcome exists only after release.
